audience: team managers who plan staffing and review department performance in Workfeed

useCases.title: Review next week’s staffing
useCases.text: Review shifts by department and role to spot unassigned work before finalizing the rota.

useCases.title: Check availability and overlapping leave
useCases.text: Compare staff availability and leave for the scheduling period before deciding who can cover a shift.

useCases.title: Review daily labor costs and revenue
useCases.text: Compare calculated department labor costs and revenue with stored daily targets and manual revenue records.

useCases.title: Create an approved shift
useCases.text: Create a shift after reviewing its staff member, role and exact times, or leave it unassigned. Publishing a shift cannot be undone through this connector.

useCases.title: Update an existing shift after review
useCases.text: Read the current shift, review the proposed changes and update it with explicit confirmation. Keep its original dates and inspect uncertain outcomes before retrying.
